title: NASA and Partners Expand Crucial Water Tracking Program
lineage: Publisher or operator text. Local file preserves selected passages and research notes.

passages.note: NASA dates availability of OpenET data for the 48 contiguous states across all tools to 15 December 2025. Data Explorer originally launched in 2021 with 17 western states; the FARMS tool was launched in early 2025 with 27 states.
passages.quote: On Dec. 15, data became available for 48 states across all tools.
